newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK CAPITAL MKT COMMISSION OKS XIOSBANK IPO.
newsitem.headline: GREEK CAPITAL MKT COMMISSION OKS XIOSBANK IPO.

text.p: Greece's capital markets commission has approved the initial public offering of private Xiosbank for listing on the Athens bourse's main market.
Xiosbank expects the IPO subscription period to run from April 15-18, it said in a statement.
The bank will issue a total of 1,672,060 new common registered shares of which 1,592,450 will be offered to the public while 79,610 will be privately placed with its staff.
Following the IPO, the bank's total outstanding shares will amount to 7,962,220 with a par value of 1,000 drachmas.

The IPO price will be announced a few days prior to the subscription period. Xiosbank expects to raise over 4.0 billion drachmas and will use proceeds to finance its investment programme for the period 1997-2000, it said.
A significant portion of the offering will be placed abroad through James Capel.
Xiosbank plans to expand its branch network by 20 branches so that by the year 2000 they will reach a total of 45.
Its fiscal 1996 pretax profit rose 20 percent to 2.1 billion drachmas and this year's projections see profits growing to 2.7 billion. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
